events.title: Provider earnings move to SN25
events.detail: Earnings from contracts settled after this cutoff are paid through SN25. Legacy USDC payouts cover only earlier earnings.

events.title: Version 1 contracts deployed
events.detail: Eight deployment steps on Bittensor's EVM, in blocks 9,239,983 to 9,240,067. The coordinator, created at 18:08 UTC, starts epoch 0.

sources.label: Reserve sink linked to the coordinator, block 9,240,039
Vault linked to the coordinator, block 9,240,049

events.title: Network operator 1 registered
events.detail: The governance Safe registers the UR operator, network operator 1, and its pool, SN25 UID 169.

sources.label: Registration through the governance Safe, block 9,240,168

events.title: Version 1 validator activated
events.detail: SN25's sole validator, UID 1, publishes its activation for epoch 1 on chain.

events.title: Weekly epochs scheduled
events.detail: The governance Safe sets 7-day epochs of 50,400 blocks from epoch 1.

sources.label: Epoch schedule through the governance Safe, block 9,240,407

events.title: Network operator settlement switched on
events.detail: The network operator's servers switch on SN25 mainnet settlement.

events.title: Signed client-key registration live
events.detail: The first providers register their client keys with a signature for SN25.

events.title: Epoch 1 begins: the first payout epoch
events.detail: The first weekly payout epoch, and the one the version 1 validator activated for, starts at block 9,247,228.

events.title: Last USDC payout batch
events.detail: The last batch of legacy USDC provider payouts.

events.title: Bittensor runtime 478 on mainnet
events.detail: The chain upgrades again, after runtime 477 on October 12. The settlement v2 contracts passed their rehearsal on runtime 478.

events.title: Settlement v2 start moved to epoch 3
events.detail: The subnet owner moves the start of settlement v2 from epoch 2 to epoch 3.

events.title: Gas policy for settlement v2 in place
events.detail: The network operator's servers load the gas policy for settlement v2's epoch closes.

events.title: Settlement v2 release not ready by October 16
events.detail: The settlement v2 release had not passed its final checks by the morning of October 16, so the rollout dates planned after it did not hold. The release went out from October 22 to 25, too late for epoch 3.

events.title: Epoch 1 closes on version 1
events.detail: Epoch 1 closed at block 9,297,631, within its 120-block close window, and the settlement vault took in its 3,482.26 α. Epoch 1 had no eligible work to pay out, so no payout root was committed by block 9,298,828, and its funding carried forward (see the notice at the top).

events.title: Epoch 1 finalized without a payout root
events.detail: Epoch 1 had no payout root, so it had no version 1 claims. Its 3,482.26 α carried forward under the protocol's missed-commit rule, and it is recovered with epoch 3's funding (see the notice at the top).

events.title: Settlement v2 not registered for epoch 3
events.detail: No v2 pool was registered in the window, blocks 9,333,628 to 9,340,828, so epoch 3 stays on version 1. Registration cannot activate an epoch that has already begun.

events.title: Settlement v2 validator starts, v2 off
events.detail: The validator started its settlement v2 release, on unchanged settings.

events.title: Settlement v2 contracts deployed
events.detail: Six deployment steps on Bittensor's EVM, in blocks 9,344,278 to 9,344,859, put vault2, which holds the funds, STSettlement2 and a claim batcher on chain beside the unchanged version 1 contracts. Deploying them does not activate settlement v2: the v2 pool must also be registered.

events.title: Validator adopts its settlement v2 settings
events.detail: The validator restarted on its settlement v2 settings, after the v2 contracts were deployed that morning.

events.title: Epoch 3 begins on version 1
events.detail: Epoch 3 starts at block 9,348,028 without a v2 pool registered, so version 1 settles it. Epoch 2 was not closed in its 120-block close window, so its emission was deferred to epoch 3's close.

events.title: Network operator services updated, v2 off
events.detail: The network operator's services moved to the settlement v2 release with v2 still switched off: the api on October 23, the others on October 24.

events.title: Connect service updated, v2 off
events.detail: The network operator's connect service moved to the settlement v2 release with its other services.

events.title: Settlement v2 pool registered
events.detail: The governance Safe registered network operator 1's pool in the v2 vault on October 29 at 03:11 UTC, before epoch 4 began, with epoch 4 as its first v2 epoch. This was the activation of settlement v2.

sources.label: Registration through the governance Safe, block 9,386,659

events.title: Network operator switches to the v2 contracts
events.detail: The network operator's servers on all six of its hosts switched to the settlement v2 contracts, ahead of the v2 pool registration.

events.title: Epoch 2 finalized without a payout root
events.detail: Epoch 2 was not closed in its close window, so its emission stayed on the pool and was taken in at epoch 3's close: epoch 3's 4,132.72 α covers about two weeks. With no funding and no payout root, epoch 2 had no version 1 claims.

events.title: Settlement v2 active: epoch 4 begins
events.detail: From block 9,398,428, settlement v2 pays epoch 4 and every epoch after it. Epoch 3 closed on version 1 without a payout root; its funding is recovered (see the notice at the top).

events.title: Epoch 3 finalized without a payout root
events.detail: Epoch 3's payout root was not committed in its window, so it had no version 1 claims. Its 4,132.72 α carried forward with epoch 1's 3,482.26 α, and both are recovered (see the notice at the top).

events.title: Settlement v2 changes now wait 72 hours
events.detail: The settlement v2 contract that runs payouts is now owned by a timelock. Any change to it, such as an upgrade, a new auditor set or adding recovered funds to an epoch, is announced on chain and waits 72 hours, and can be cancelled during that time. Payout roots, approvals and claims are unaffected.

events.title: First settlement v2 close and commit
events.detail: Epoch 4 ended at block 9,448,828. Its v2 ledger root was committed at block 9,449,034 and approved by the validator at block 9,449,041.

events.title: Recovery root sends the epoch 1 and 3 funding to the v2 vault
events.detail: A single version 1 root pays the whole carry, 3,482.26 α from epoch 1 and 4,132.72 α from epoch 3, to the v2 vault. It can be claimed into the vault after its 48-hour challenge period, from about November 8, 18:25 UTC.

events.title: First settlement v2 claims
events.detail: Epoch 4's root, the first v2 root, finalized at block 9,463,438, 14,404 blocks after its commit, and the first claims followed at block 9,463,447.

events.title: Recovered funds not scheduled into epoch 5
events.detail: The recovery reached the v2 vault on November 8 at 18:30 UTC. Adding it to epoch 5's payout had to be scheduled through the 72-hour timelock by about November 10, 18:25 UTC, to take effect before epoch 5 closes. It was not scheduled, so the recovered funds are not paid with epoch 5 (see the notice at the top). The recovery's record on the v2 settlement contract was scheduled on November 6 and has been ready to take effect since November 9, 21:19 UTC.

sources.label: Recovery claimed into the v2 vault, block 9,463,236
Recovery taken into the v2 vault's escrow, block 9,463,240

events.title: Modern provider gate retired: modern providers are drawn first
events.detail: The gate that would have admitted only providers verified as modern to Quality and Speed did not turn on: on October 28 the subnet owner replaced it with priority. Within each band, providers verified as modern are drawn first and other providers fill what is left, so those keep their Quality and Speed membership. Priority reached the network operator's services that evening, from 22:37 to 23:20 UTC.

events.title: Same-network and friends-and-family traffic now draws on the data balance
events.detail: Traffic between devices of one network and traffic to a provider in friends-and-family mode now draw on the sending network's data balance, as other traffic does, on the free plan or a paid one. The billing change, approved by the subnet owner on November 10, reached the network operator's services in stages from 05:43 UTC, and all of them by 11:39 UTC. Friends-and-family providers are credited for it as before: paid and free traffic count alike. Contracts opened before the change are not charged.

events.title: Epoch 5 claims
events.detail: Epoch 5 ends at block 9,499,228, and claims follow its 14,400-block challenge period. The recovered epoch 1 and 3 funding is not part of epoch 5's payout: adding it was not scheduled in time (see the notice at the top).

events.title: Signed price goes live: demand deposits from epoch 7
events.detail: From block 9,549,628, the network operator deposits 0.010437 α per GiB and 0.005218 α per active user of epoch 6, capped at 3,000 α per epoch, as signed by the subnet owner in price.yml (published November 3). Validators check each epoch's deposit against it at every steering pass, with the validator release that ships before epoch 7. Until the deposit matches what the previous epoch's usage owes, the operator's pool gets no weight.

sources.label: The signed price in the sn repo

events.title: Extender pool for intra-platform and intra-network traffic, from epoch 8
events.detail: From block 9,600,028, the first of epoch 8, the part of each contract's traffic that no provider earns counts for extenders instead. That covers traffic between a client and the network operator's platform, and traffic between devices of one network. The operator's pool spreads it evenly over each /29 IPv4 or /48 IPv6 block that holds an eligible extender, then evenly over the extenders in it, up to the epoch's eligible provider usage, so extenders earn at most half of a pool. An extender that carries a contract keeps its own share of it, as one of the contract's hops, as the subnet owner decided on November 11. Approved by the subnet owner on November 10, it takes effect once the signed amendment entry is published before epoch 8 starts.
